windows.name: CRIME
windows.note: CPU interface and memory controller registers (CRIME 1.5 spec, table 5-7, 6-12)

windows.name: RE
windows.note: rendering engine, offsets from 0x15000000 (CRIME 1.5 spec, figure 7-3)

windows.name: MACEV
windows.note: MACE video in 1, video in 2 and video out, three 0x80000 windows from 0x1f100000 (Linux asm/ip32/mace.h struct sgi_mace)

windows.name: MACEAV
windows.note: the audio and video block the CRIME specification system map lists at 0x1f400000

field_pointers.why: gc+32184 is the hardware pointer libGLcore stores register writes through (docs/context.md)
board record +120 holds the KSEG1 pointer to 0x15000000 (crime_kernel/include/crime_kern.h CRB_RE_BASE)
crimeBoards+4 holds the GBE KSEG1 base (crime_kernel/include/crime_kern.h)

argument_pointers.why: gbeProbe reads the device id at +0x14 of its first argument and compares it with 0x666 (docs/gbe.md, GBE.h)
